note: Rejudged after handleLCPPacket gained a Protocol-Reject branch (RFC 1661 Section 5.7) and connectedSession.restart moved its NPMode constants to pppkernel. Re-read Section 4.3's immediate-renegotiation sentence and the Section 4.1 Opened RCR+/RCR- cells. The new branch runs only for pkt.Code == LCPProtocolReject: outside Opened it returns before codeToEvent, and in Opened it hands the Rejected-Protocol to receiveProtocolReject. A Configure-Request reaches evalLCPRequest, the Opened resetAuthNegotiation and LCPDoTransition along byte-identical code, and the restart change is an import rename with the same modes. All six tagged units are unchanged and send no Protocol-Reject. The server tests still require exact tld/scr/sca or tld/scr/scn actions, Ack-Sent, the Configure-Request and Ack output and no session-down event. The Echo control still refuses scr/tld. The client Auth, IPCP and Network probes still require their own Configure-Request before an exact peer Ack, Identifier 0x73 and Magic 0x55667788. The earlier judgment stands, and its record caveat still applies: the mutant records cover phase dispatch, and the producer-disable records prove only reachability.
